Sample.evidence_source: [/page/10/Text/5] The ANOVA showed a significant difference among children from the different types of families, F(3, 171) = 3.59, p < .05.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/10/Text/2] The fourth goal of Study 1 was to investigate the relationship between family structure and depression in Chinese children. Specifically, we expected that children from single-parent families would be more depressed than children from other types of families and that children from extended families would be less depressed compared to children from other types of families.

MedCat.evidence_source: [/page/10/Text/5] Post hoc tests revealed a significantly higher frequency of depressive symptoms in children from single-parent families (M = 13.40, SD = 7.07) as compared to children from nuclear families (M = 7.70, SD = 4.40), post hoc pairwise comparison p < .05.
